product_contract.note: P0.1 is on main. Node + iframe is a transition bridge; end state is native host migration; two auth spaces stay separate; user-facing dual entry uses studio / room wording.

north_star.end_state: Migrate openXYOS web/org capabilities into the FreeOS/Octop host as native parts. Do not permanently ship a large Node runtime.
north_star.bridge: Managed Node + iframe on desktop is a transition only.
north_star.dual_entry: FreeOS local studio vs organization as another room. Soft wording in user docs; implementers keep two auth spaces separate.
north_star.assets: Bidirectional assets; exportable openXYOS source for commercialization; local models/KB.

slogans.zh: FreeOS：自由的 AI 工作室，想象空间由你来打开

inventory_limitation: docs/org-full-parity-inventory.json is a static route scan. host_route_exists=true is not functional parity; every route is still parity=not_accepted. Dynamic URLs, permissions, and data relations need runtime review.

waves.title: Bidirectional assets bus
waves.goal: Make FreeOS ↔ organization pack/ingest/apply a first-class native bus, not live HTTP that only works when Node is healthy.

waves.title: Exportable openXYOS source
waves.goal: Move past SPA + proxy-to-host. Operators should export a commercializable openXYOS source tree from the same product.

waves.title: Dual-identity UX
waves.goal: Studio login and organization-room login stay two spaces. User docs stay soft (studio vs another room). Do not collapse into one way in, and do not make org identity the host authority.

waves.title: Local models and knowledge bases
waves.goal: Default chat, RAG, and organization knowledge must not require a vendor cloud.

waves.title: Cut Node
waves.goal: Native-port remaining iframe App surfaces, then shrink managed Node and optional sidecar. Node is a bridge, not the architecture.

do_not_treat_as_end_state.item: Desktop integrated iframe of the full openXYOS App
evidence: src/octop/api/routers/org_ui.py proxies /organization-app to the managed Node origin
do_not_treat_as_end_state.native_port_needed: Every App.tsx business route still served only through this iframe.
Replace Node business APIs with host routers; keep process only while unmigrated routes remain.

do_not_treat_as_end_state.item: Same-origin business proxy /api/org-module/business/* and identity login/register/refresh
do_not_treat_as_end_state.native_port_needed: Org-room CRUD and auth must not require a Node hop.
Compatibility hatch for export/sync only; not a second always-on product.

do_not_treat_as_end_state.item: Open-12 host slices that omit original App depth
evidence: docs/org-merge-plan.md postponed reporting-lines, talent market, sidecar marketplace, Chat, company/AI/DB settings
do_not_treat_as_end_state.native_port_needed: Deepen org-ui + host APIs until App.tsx fields/relations work without Node.
Do not revive as the Organization home. Delete or keep as advanced compat only after native pages own the surface.
